raw: {"analysis":"Response NMB provides a more actionable and complete plan, correctly sequencing the parser fix before the migration, identifying the EU-West cluster as the deployment target, and including a Finance reconciliation check. Response CTP has a critical sequencing error—placing the parser update inside Lane B alongside the migration rather than ensuring it lands first—and confusingly suggests merging the shared library before backend work, which inverts the natural dependency flow. Response NMB also handles the irreversible migration more pragmatically with isolated replica verification and a feature flag, while Response CTP's compensating transaction script adds unnecessary complexity without addressing the core irreversibility risk.","verdict":"NMB"}
